CREATE VIEW BI_AccountingInvoices
 --drop view BI_AccountingInvoices

AS

SELECT
    CC.AIT1 AS [GL],
    CC.AIT2 AS [AIT2],
    CC.AIT3 AS [AIT3],
    CC.AIT4 AS [AIT4],
    CC.AIT5 AS [AIT5],
    CC.AIT6 AS [AIT6],
    CC.AIT7 AS [AIT7],
    CC.ACDT AS [Invoice Date],
    CC.ACAM AS [Amount],
    CC.EXIN AS [Invoice Number],
    CC.ORNO AS [Order Number],
    CC.DLIX AS [Delivery Number],
    CC.PYNO AS [Payer Number],
    CC.CUNO AS [Customer Number],
    OH.VONO AS [Voucher Number],
    ODL.ITNO AS [Item Number]
FROM M3.OINACC CC
LEFT JOIN M3.OINVOH OH ON CC.EXIN = OH.EXIN AND CC.PYNO = OH.PYNO
LEFT JOIN M3.ODLINE ODL ON
    CC.EXIN = ODL.EXIN AND
    CC.DLIX = ODL.DLIX AND
    CAST(LEFT(CC.IVRF, CHARINDEX(' ', CC.IVRF)) AS INT) = ODL.PONR AND
    CAST(SUBSTRING(CC.IVRF, 6, LEN(CC.IVRF) ) AS INT) = ODL.POSX AND
    CAST(SUBSTRING(CC.IVRF, 6, LEN(CC.IVRF) ) AS INT) = ODL.POSX
WHERE CC.TRCD = 11 AND CC.YEA4 > 2024 AND CC.AIT1 IN ( '421055', '421070', '421050', '421060' )
